AcceptRead.description:
The accept's whole answer: the entity born, and the proposed relations
that could not be placed. The skips are transient — the response carries
them once (D8), the UI announces them, nothing persists them.
AcceptRead.title: AcceptRead

ArchiveInvalidRead.description: The 422 detail when the archive itself is unreadable or malformed.
ArchiveInvalidRead.title: ArchiveInvalidRead

AssignmentUpdate.description: ``profile_id: null`` clears the task's assignment (back down the cascade).
AssignmentUpdate.title: AssignmentUpdate

ConflictRead.description:
One item the merge rules refused: which archive file, and why.

`file` carries the archive-side path the parse stamped on the item —
untrusted text, a plain string by contract. `code` is the stable key the
receipt localizes, with `params` interpolated; `reason` is the technical
detail, and the fallback for a code the client does not know.
ConflictRead.title: ConflictRead

ConsistencyAccepted.description: The check's enqueue answer: what to poll.
ConsistencyAccepted.title: ConsistencyAccepted

EmbeddingMismatchDetail.description: Identify incompatible stored and current embedding widths.
EmbeddingMismatchDetail.title: EmbeddingMismatchDetail

EmbeddingMismatchRead.description: The HTTP 409 body returned when source embeddings are incompatible.
EmbeddingMismatchRead.title: EmbeddingMismatchRead

EntityMerge.description: The merge's whole ask: which row survives.
EntityMerge.title: EntityMerge

EntityUpdate.description:
The PATCH body: only the fields present are the change.

``None`` is ambiguous by shape alone — an absent field and a cleared
content both look like None — so the service reads
``model_fields_set`` to tell a carried change from a missing one. The
values are checked there, against the parse contract's vocabulary and
the label rules: this schema carries the fields, the contract decides
what a value may be. A carried ``null`` content clears the body.
EntityUpdate.title: EntityUpdate

ExportDone.description: The receipt of a path export: where it went and how much.
ExportDone.title: ExportDone

ExportRequest.description: One export: into a directory on disk, or as a ZIP download.
ExportRequest.title: ExportRequest

ExtractionAccepted.description: The enqueue's whole answer: what to poll.
ExtractionAccepted.title: ExtractionAccepted

ExtractionRequest.description: Which chapter of the novel the worker should read.
ExtractionRequest.title: ExtractionRequest

FieldRefusalRead.description: One refused field inside a 422 body — `loc` names the request part.
FieldRefusalRead.title: FieldRefusalRead

FieldRefusalsRead.description: The 422 body when the request breaks a field contract.
FieldRefusalsRead.title: FieldRefusalsRead

ImportRefusalsRead.description: The import's 422 body: a refused field, or the offending archive file.
ImportRefusalsRead.title: ImportRefusalsRead

ImportReportRead.description:
What one import did, per class — the engine's report, field by field.

Every matched item lands in exactly one of new / revised / renamed /
already_current; an item a conflict refused increments nothing.
ImportReportRead.title: ImportReportRead

JobRead.description: What a UI polls: the row's state, not its payload.
JobRead.title: JobRead

ProfileCreate.description: One new provider profile. ``api_key`` is write-only; the mask comes back.
ProfileCreate.title: ProfileCreate

ProfileCreated.description:
The create's answer: the one response that carries the full key.

``api_key`` is the plaintext exactly once, for the client that just sent
it to confirm against; it is ``None`` when no key was stored (a fake, or
a local endpoint without one).
ProfileCreated.title: ProfileCreated

ProfileRead.description: A profile as every read shows it: the mask, never the key.
ProfileRead.title: ProfileRead

ProfileTestResult.description: What one connection test found: it ran, and it either answered or named why.
ProfileTestResult.title: ProfileTestResult

ProfileUpdate.description:
What a patch may change. The kind is what the profile is: not editable.

Absent fields stay unchanged; present nulls clear the nullable columns.
``is_default: true`` hands the default over from the current holder.
ProfileUpdate.title: ProfileUpdate

PromptDetail.description:
One key as the editor shows it: the bundled source, the variable
legend, the override in force, the source a render would use.
PromptDetail.title: PromptDetail

PromptDiff.description: The bundled template against the override in force for the scope.
PromptDiff.title: PromptDiff

PromptOverride.description: The override in force for the scope: which tier answered, its content.
PromptOverride.title: PromptOverride

PromptSave.description: One override write. ``novel_id`` absent or null saves the global tier.
PromptSave.title: PromptSave

PromptSummary.description:
One bundled key in the list, with its two override tiers as facts.

``override_novel`` is meaningful only when the read carried a
``novel_id``; without one there is no novel tier to ask.
PromptSummary.title: PromptSummary

PromptVariable.description: One variable of the template, with the sample value as its example.
PromptVariable.title: PromptVariable

ProposedRelationRead.description:
One proposed relation as review reads it: the target's name and the type.

The stored proposals speak the extraction answer's keys (``target``,
``type``); the read shape names them target_name and relation_type, and
both spellings validate.
ProposedRelationRead.title: ProposedRelationRead

ReembedResult.description:
What a re-embed rebuilt: every document and every chunk of it — the
corpus ends at one width again.
ReembedResult.title: ReembedResult

RelationCreate.description:
The POST body of an edge: the other end, a free-text type, a note.

The type is free text on purpose (D7) — the suggested vocabulary is a
UI autocomplete, not an API constraint; the service checks blankness
and length, the ends are taken from the path and this body and are
immutable afterwards.
RelationCreate.title: RelationCreate

RelationPatch.description:
The PATCH body of an edge: type and note only.

The ends are immutable — moving an edge is delete plus create — so no
field here could carry them. ``model_fields_set`` tells a carried
``null`` note (cleared) from an absent one (untouched).
RelationPatch.title: RelationPatch

SkippedRelationRead.description:
A proposed relation accept could not place: the target's name as the
proposal spelled it, the type as stored — the stripped form, not the
proposal's raw words.
SkippedRelationRead.title: SkippedRelationRead

TaskEffectiveRead.description:
One known task key and the tier that actually serves it.

``profile_id`` and ``profile_name`` are ``None`` exactly when no profile
serves — the environment tier answers. ``kind`` names the serving adapter
either way (``fake`` or ``openai-chat``), so the page can say what answers
without claiming the cascade's stored choice. An audit-only key has no
serving tier: ``kind`` is ``audit``, the profile fields are ``None``, and
``assignable`` is ``False``.
TaskEffectiveRead.title: TaskEffectiveRead

WritingErrorRead.description: The JSON body for missing resources and incomplete setup.
WritingErrorRead.title: WritingErrorRead

post.description: Stream a sourced answer; return HTTP 409 for incompatible source embeddings.

text/event-stream.description: Server-sent events: data frames for the sources and the answer, then one terminal event: done or error.

get.description: Return an owned job's state; absent and other users' jobs both raise HTTP 404.

schema.title: Response List Documents Api Knowledge Documents Get

post.description: Ingest a text file. Plain text only; the body is decoded as UTF-8.

delete.description:
Delete an entity. Its relations' foreign keys cascade: the edges go
with the row.

Raise HTTP 404 for an absent or unowned entity.

patch.description:
Correct an entity by hand: only the fields the body carries change.

Return the entity; raise HTTP 404 for an absent or unowned entity, or
HTTP 422 for an invalid name, type, alias or tag — a null content
clears the body.

post.description:
Fold this entity into another: the target survives, the source is
deleted, and the source's edges re-point and its fields fold into the
survivor.

Return the folded target; raise HTTP 404 if either entity is absent or
unowned, or HTTP 422 for a self-merge or a target in another novel.

get.description:
The entity's relations, both directions, oldest first.

Raise HTTP 404 for an absent or unowned entity — another user's rows
are the same absence, including their edges.

schema.title: Response List Relations Api Knowledge Entities  Entity Id  Relations Get

post.description:
Create a directed edge to another entity of the same novel.

Self-relations are allowed. Raise HTTP 404 when either end is absent
or unowned or not of this novel, HTTP 422 for a blank or over-long
type, or HTTP 409 when this exact edge carries the type already.

Enqueue entity extraction for a chapter. The worker does the rest; poll
``GET /api/jobs/{job_id}`` — the row's state is the answer.

Respond with HTTP 404 for an absent or unowned novel or chapter, including
a chapter from a different novel, or HTTP 409 when setup is required.

Acknowledge: the finding is consumed — seen, the text stays as it is.

Return the finding; raise HTTP 404 for an absent or unowned finding,
or HTTP 409 for an already reviewed finding.

Dismiss a finding and return its retained row with status dismissed.

Raise HTTP 404 for an absent or unowned finding, or HTTP 409 if already reviewed.

get.description:
The novel's entities: filtered by type and tag, or fuzzy-found by q
(the trigram tier); unfiltered, oldest first.

Raise HTTP 404 for an absent or unowned novel.

schema.title: Response List Entities Api Knowledge Novels  Novel Id  Entities Get

get.description:
The novel's findings in one review state; pending is the queue.

Return them oldest first; raise HTTP 404 for an absent or unowned novel.

schema.title: Response List Findings Api Knowledge Novels  Novel Id  Findings Get

get.description:
The novel's suggestions in one review state; pending is the queue.

Return them oldest first; raise HTTP 404 for an absent or unowned novel.

schema.title: Response List Suggestions Api Knowledge Novels  Novel Id  Suggestions Get

post.description: Re-embed the corpus through the configured model: the mismatch fix.

delete.description:
Delete one edge: exactly the edge.

Raise HTTP 404 for an absent or unowned edge.

patch.description:
Retype or re-note an edge; the ends are immutable.

Return the edge; raise HTTP 404 for an absent or unowned edge,
HTTP 422 for a blank or over-long type, or HTTP 409 when the new type
would duplicate the edge's sibling.

schema.title: Response Search Api Knowledge Search Post

post.description:
Accept: the entity is created, its proposed relations placed, and the
suggestion consumed, once.

Return the entity and the proposals that could not be placed — a target
still pending, absent, or ambiguous (D8); the UI announces them once,
and no ledger keeps them. Raise HTTP 404 for an absent or unowned
suggestion, or HTTP 409 for an already reviewed suggestion.

Discard: the suggestion is consumed without creating anything.

Return the suggestion; raise HTTP 404 for an absent or unowned suggestion,
or HTTP 409 for an already reviewed suggestion.

get.description: Every bundled prompt with its facts and its two override tiers.

schema.title: Response List Prompts Api Prompts Get

delete.description: Reset the override for the scope; the other tier is untouched.

get.description: One prompt as the editor shows it: bundled source, legend, override.

put.description: Validate and save the override for the scope; the fresh detail answers.

get.description: The bundled template against the override in force for the scope.
Every task assignment of the user's, ordered by task key.

schema.title: Response List Assignments Api Settings Assignments Get

put.description:
Point the task at a profile, or clear it with ``profile_id: null``.

Any non-empty task key is accepted — unknown keys are forward-compatible.

get.description: The user's profiles, the default first; every key read shows the mask.

schema.title: Response List Profiles Api Settings Profiles Get

post.description: Store one profile; the first becomes the default; the full key returns once.

delete.description: Delete a non-default profile; its assignments cascade with it.

patch.description: Apply the patch; an empty ``api_key`` keeps the stored one.

get.description: Model discovery against the profile's endpoint.

schema.title: Response List Profile Models Api Settings Profiles  Profile Id  Models Get

post.description: One cheap completion against the profile's endpoint, audited as settings.test.

get.description:
The effective provider per known task key, for the page's task list.

Reads only: each row is the resolution cascade's answer, never a write
and never an audit row. A profile whose key its tier can no longer
produce fails the read by name — 502, as discovery maps the same class —
so a lost key is never a bare 500.

schema.title: Response List Tasks Api Settings Tasks Get

get.description: Return an owned chapter; respond with HTTP 404 when it is not found.

put.description: Update an owned chapter; respond with HTTP 404 when it is not found.

post.description: Stream a continuation for an owned chapter; return HTTP 404 when it is not found.

text/event-stream.description: Server-sent events: data frames of the continuation, then one terminal event: done or error.

schema.title: Response List Novels Api Writing Novels Get

post.description: Create and return a novel; respond with HTTP 409 if setup is required.

Import one archive as a new novel, or merged into an owned one.

The archive arrives as an upload or as a server-side path — exactly one
of the two. Respond with HTTP 404 for an absent or unowned target novel,
HTTP 413 for an oversized archive, HTTP 422 naming the field for a
source contract break or an unreachable path, HTTP 422 with the offending
file named for an unreadable or malformed archive, or HTTP 409 for a
new-novel import before setup (`setup required`).

409.description: Setup is required (a new-novel import needs the user setup creates)

413.description: The archive is larger than 20 000 000 bytes

422.description: A source contract break, named in `detail[].loc`, or an unreadable archive whose file is named in `detail.file`

get.description: Return an owned novel; respond with HTTP 404 when it is not found.
List chapters of an owned novel; respond with HTTP 404 when it is not found.

schema.title: Response List Chapters Api Writing Novels  Novel Id  Chapters Get

post.description: Create a chapter; return HTTP 404 for a missing novel or HTTP 409 if setup is required.

Export an owned novel as a ZIP download or into a directory on disk.

The ZIP answer carries ``Content-Disposition: attachment`` named after the
title's slug; the path answer is the receipt: where it went and how much.
Respond with HTTP 404 for an absent or unowned novel, HTTP 409 when the
target exists and is non-empty, or HTTP 422 naming the field for a
missing, unwritable or file target path.

409.description: The target exists and is non-empty

422.description: A missing, unwritable or file target path, named in `detail[].loc`
